title: Sugarcane farmers block highways across Karnataka demanding higher prices

tea.why: Sugarcane farmers protested because discussions between farmer representatives and Union Ministers in New Delhi failed to yield a solution.
tea.want: Farmers demanded higher prices for their produce, an increase in minimum support prices, and the Swaminathan Commission's recommendations.
tea.changed: Oct 14: Kittur Rani Channamma University postponed all examinations scheduled for the day due to the ongoing protests.

summary: Sugarcane growers blocked national highways at multiple locations across Karnataka, including Belagavi, Bagalkot, Vijayapura, Dharwad, Gadag, and Haveri districts. The demonstrations disrupted traffic on key routes like the Pune-Bengaluru National Highway. Organised after talks between farmer representatives and Union Ministers failed in New Delhi, the demonstrators demanded a remunerative price covering production costs, a revision of the minimum selling price of sugar, and the implementation of the Swaminathan Commission's recommendations. Protesters sat on roadways and prevented vehicle movement at various toll plazas and check-posts. Authorities deployed additional police personnel and State Reserve Police forces as a precautionary measure, while traffic police diverted vehicles to minimise disruptions. Union Food Minister Pralhad Joshi appealed to the participants to withdraw the agitation, assuring them that the central government would address their concerns.
demands: Increase in the Minimum Support Price
Revision of the minimum selling price of sugar
Implementation of the Swaminathan Commission's recommendations
response: Union Food Minister Pralhad Joshi appealed to the farmers to withdraw their agitation, assuring them that the Centre and state governments would work together to address their concerns.

updates.text: Sugarcane farmers blocked national highways at several locations across Karnataka to demand higher prices.
Kittur Rani Channamma University postponed examinations scheduled for the day due to the ongoing highway blockades.
